post.description: Transmit a server-side conversion event to LinkedIn via the Conversions API. Events are matched to LinkedIn members through hashed user identifiers (email, first name, last name, title, company, country). The conversion parameter must reference an existing conversion action configured in LinkedIn Campaign Manager. Request body: Body: {account (required, string — LinkedIn Ads account ID), conversion (required, string — conversion action name or URN), email (optional, string — user email for identity matching), first_name (optional, string), last_name (optional, string), title (optional, string — job title), company (optional, string — company name), country (optional, string — two-letter country code), linkedin_first_party_ads_tracking_uuid (optional, string — first party cookie ID from li_fat_id), lead_id (optional, string — LinkedIn Lead ID from Lead Gen Forms), amount (optional, number — monetary value of the conversion), currency_code (optional, string — ISO 4217 currency code, default USD), conversion_happened_at (optional, string — ISO 8601 timestamp when conversion occurred), event_id (optional, string — custom event ID from advertiser for deduplication)}.

schema.description: Body: {account (required, string — LinkedIn Ads account ID), conversion (required, string — conversion action name or URN), email (optional, string — user email for identity matching), first_name (optional, string), last_name (optional, string), title (optional, string — job title), company (optional, string — company name), country (optional, string — two-letter country code), linkedin_first_party_ads_tracking_uuid (optional, string — first party cookie ID from li_fat_id), lead_id (optional, string — LinkedIn Lead ID from Lead Gen Forms), amount (optional, number — monetary value of the conversion), currency_code (optional, string — ISO 4217 currency code, default USD), conversion_happened_at (optional, string — ISO 8601 timestamp when conversion occurred), event_id (optional, string — custom event ID from advertiser for deduplication)}

email.description: User's email address, used to match the event to a LinkedIn member.

amount.description: Monetary amount associated with the conversion.

account.description: The LinkedIn Ads account ID associated with this event.

company.description: Name of the user's employer or company.

country.description: Two-character ISO country code for the user.

conversion.description: Name or URN of the conversion action being recorded.

currency_code.description: Currency denomination as an ISO 4217 code (e.g., USD).

conversion_happened_at.description: Date and time at which the conversion took place.

ConversionEvent.description: A conversion event submitted through the LinkedIn Conversions API.
